top_signals.title: Tencent, Visa deepen payments push in China after regulatory green light
top_signals.summary: Tencent and Visa are expanding their payments partnership following recent regulatory approvals for foreign financial firms in China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
